summary: Thai dental clinic (YMYL), seven pages, with canonical, duplicate-title, broken JSON-LD, authorship and llms.txt defects.

expected_facts.fact: The implant and braces service pages both carry a canonical pointing to the home page (https://smileplus-dental.test/) instead of themselves, which asks search engines to drop them.
The three service pages (implant, braces, whitening) share one identical title tag: "บริการทันตกรรม | สไมล์พลัส".
The FAQPage JSON-LD on /articles/implant-cost/ is invalid JSON (a trailing comma before the closing bracket), so it is not usable as structured data.

The medical cost article is credited only to "ทีมงานสไมล์พลัส" (the clinic team), with no named dentist or licence, a weak E-E-A-T signal on a YMYL topic, even though /doctors/ lists dentists with licence numbers.
llms.txt exists but does not follow the format: it has no '# ' H1 title line, no '>' summary and plain URLs instead of Markdown links, and one of its two links (/promotion/) returns 404.
The home page has valid Dentist structured data with address, telephone and opening hours.
robots.txt allows every crawler (one * group with Allow: /) and points to sitemap.xml, which lists 7 URLs that all return 200.
